name: Antimanual – Automate manual tasks with 24/7 AI Agent (Article Writer, AI Chatbot, Auto Posting, Auto Reply, FAQ Generator, Bulk Rewriter, Docs Generator etc)
author: Spider Themes

sections.description:
Antimanual is the all-in-one AI plugin for WordPress — a single, modern dashboard that brings together a trainable AI chatbot, automated content publishing, bulk content rewriting, FAQ generator, documentation builder, repurpose studio, forum automation, AI-powered search, AI translation, powerful SEO auditing, and intelligent internal linking.

Whether you run a SaaS product, an online store, a blog, or a community forum, Antimanual replaces multiple plugins with one tool and puts your most time-consuming site tasks on autopilot — no coding required.

Use your own API key — we don’t charge for it. Antimanual works with your own OpenAI or Google Gemini API key. Both providers are supported in the free version, so you stay in full control of your AI usage and costs.

Useful Links

  • Antimanual Pro — Remove usage limits and unlock premium features.
  • Documentation — Setup guides and feature walkthroughs.
  • Support Forum — Get help from the team.

Who Is Antimanual For?

  • SaaS & Product Companies — Deploy a trained chatbot for instant support, generate product documentation, and index your GitHub repos for an AI assistant that knows your product inside-out.
  • Content Creators & Bloggers — Publish AI-generated posts on autopilot, repurpose articles for social and email, refresh old content at scale, and never run out of ideas.
  • Agencies & Freelancers — Deliver AI-powered WordPress sites to clients complete with chatbots, automated content, SEO tooling, and documentation — from a single plugin.
  • E-commerce & Online Stores — Reduce customer support time with an always-on chatbot, generate product descriptions and FAQs, and keep product pages optimized.
  • Community & Forum Sites — Let AI handle first-line forum responses and convert the best answers into evergreen knowledge base articles automatically.
  • SEO-Focused Sites (SEO Plus) — Run comprehensive AI SEO audits, auto-fix issues in bulk, build a stronger internal link structure, and monitor rankings in real time.
  • Multilingual Sites (Pro) — Translate your entire site into 34 languages with bulk AI translation, auto-translate on publish, and a frontend language switcher — no extra translation plugin needed.
  • Open-Source Projects & Developer Tools (Pro) — Index GitHub documentation directly into the knowledge base and give users an AI assistant that understands your codebase.

Version 3.0.0 is a major milestone.

We re-engineered and restructured the plugin from the ground up to be faster, more intuitive, and more powerful. Here are the four biggest changes you’ll notice immediately:

1. Completely Rebuilt Admin Experience — Every page in the dashboard has been redesigned from scratch. Navigation is now cleaner and icon-driven, all pages lazy-load for faster startup, and every feature page has been reorganized into a logical, step-by-step layout with better help texts and visual feedback throughout.

2. Three Brand-New Content Tools — Version 3.0.0 ships with three new AI-powered tools in one update: the FAQ Generator (creates structured FAQ content with Google Schema markup in one click), the Repurpose Studio (turns any post into social media, email, and video content with Quick Presets), and Generate Post with AI (creates complete, publish-ready posts from a single prompt with title, slug, excerpt, and taxonomies).

3. Google Gemini Now Free for Everyone — You no longer need a Pro license to use Google Gemini. Free users can now connect a Gemini API key and use Gemini models for chat, embeddings, and all AI generation features — giving you a choice between OpenAI and Google AI at no extra cost.

4. Fully Redesigned Workflows for Docs & Bulk Rewrite — The Docs Generator has been rebuilt as a guided 6-step wizard with depth, audience, TOC, FAQ, internal link, and featured image controls. Bulk Rewrite now ships with 8 Quick Presets (SEO Optimization, Content Refresh, Fix Grammar, Make Concise, Add Structure, Conversational Tone, Simplify & Improve, Complete Enhancement), saved prompt templates, and prompt variables.

Powerful AI Tools at No Cost

Get started with a generous set of features built to save hours every week.

AI Chatbot — Instant 24/7 Support for Your Visitors

Train a custom chatbot on your own WordPress content. Instead of answering the same questions over and over, let the AI handle them — accurately, instantly, and around the clock. The chatbot uses vector embeddings from your knowledge base to give context-aware answers, not generic AI responses.

  • Train on any WordPress post or page in one click
  • Supports OpenAI GPT-5, GPT-4.1, GPT-4 Turbo, GPT-3.5 Turbo, and more
  • Full appearance customization: colors, icon, position, welcome message, and suggested questions
  • Fully mobile-optimized chat interface
  • Conversation history tracked in the admin dashboard
  • Custom fallback message for off-topic or irrelevant queries
  • Chatbot leads capture and analytics
  • Up to 60 conversations per month on the free plan

Auto-Posting — Publish Fresh Content Without Writing a Word

Schedule AI-generated blog posts to publish automatically. Pick your topics, tone, language, and posting schedule — Antimanual generates full Gutenberg posts and publishes them on time. Ideal for boosting SEO with consistent, fresh content.

  • AI-powered topic suggestion tool to fill your content calendar
  • Configurable tone, language, article length, and SEO settings
  • Weekday/time scheduling with optional expiration dates
  • Reliable queue system with automatic retry on failure
  • Real-time status bar with manual trigger and pause options
  • Generated posts history with search, filter, and pagination
  • Up to 2 active schedules on the free plan

Generate Post with AI — One Prompt, One Publish-Ready Post

Create complete WordPress posts from a single prompt. Antimanual generates the title, full Gutenberg block content, URL slug, excerpt, categories, and tags — ready to publish or review.

  • Smart prompt suggestions powered by your site context
  • SEO options: focus keyword, meta description, table of contents, and internal link suggestions
  • AI-generated featured image option
  • Batch mode to generate multiple posts from a list of topics at once (Pro)
  • Configurable author, status, categories, and tags
  • Full history with search, filter, sort, and pagination

FAQ Generator — AI FAQs with Google Rich Snippet Schema

Generate structured FAQ content from your knowledge base with one click. Review and edit the Q&A pairs, then insert them as Gutenberg accordion blocks — complete with FAQ Schema markup for Google rich results.

  • Generate from your entire knowledge base or specific sources
  • Customizable tone and topic focus
  • Interactive editable preview — add, edit, reorder, or delete any Q&A pair
  • Output as default Gutenberg accordion or Advanced Accordion Block format
  • FAQ Schema markup for SEO rich snippets in Google
  • Auto-saves progress to local storage to prevent data loss

Repurpose Studio — Turn One Post into Many Content Formats

Transform any existing WordPress post into social media content, email copy, video scripts, and more. Includes Quick Presets for Product Launch, Blog Summary, Event Promo, Tutorial Recap, Case Study, and Thought Leadership — making repurposing instant.

  • Generate X/Twitter, LinkedIn, and Facebook posts from any article
  • Create email newsletters and video scripts with hooks and CTAs
  • Six built-in quick presets for the most common repurposing tasks

AI Documentation Generator — Professional Docs in Minutes

Build structured product documentation with AI. Define the number of lessons, sub-lessons, tone, and target audience — then let AI write each section. Designed for SaaS platforms, software products, and any project that needs organized, professional docs.

  • 6-step guided wizard: Subject, Settings, Writing Style, Knowledge Sources, Generate, Review & Edit
  • Content depth, target audience, table of contents, FAQ, and internal link options
  • AI-generated featured image for the documentation
  • File upload support for custom source material

Bulk Rewrite — Refresh Dozens of Posts at Once

Select multiple posts and rewrite them with AI to improve readability, fix grammar, add structure, update outdated information, or optimize for new keywords. Antimanual preserves your existing Gutenberg block structure.

  • 8 built-in Quick Presets: SEO Optimization, Content Refresh, Fix Grammar, Make Concise, Add Structure, Conversational Tone, Simplify & Improve, Complete Enhancement
  • Custom rewrite prompts with saved templates and prompt variables
  • Automatically regenerate SEO-friendly excerpts, tags, and taxonomy terms
  • 100 rewrites per month on the free plan

Auto Update — Automatically Keep Old Content Relevant

Set up a schedule and let Antimanual automatically find and rewrite aging posts. Configure which post types to update, set a minimum age threshold, and the plugin handles everything else — without any manual intervention.

  • Filter by post type, post status, and content age
  • Update title, content, and excerpt independently
  • Configurable tone, language, and advanced prompt settings
  • Weekday/time scheduling with a stats dashboard
  • Exclude specific posts by ID

Forum Automation — AI-Powered Community Management

Integrate with Forumax and bbPress to automate your WordPress community forums. AI generates answers to new topics and replies, and converts solved forum threads into permanent blog posts or knowledge base articles.

  • AI auto-response for new forum topics and replies
  • Configurable minimum word count and role exclusions
  • Convert closed topics into WordPress posts with one click
  • Writing tone controls for AI responses
  • Customizable AI disclaimer text
  • Up to 100 AI answers and 100 topic conversions per month on the free plan

AI Search Block — Intelligent Gutenberg Search Widget

Add a smart, intent-aware search experience to any page using the Antimanual AI Search Gutenberg block. It queries your knowledge base to understand what visitors are looking for and returns relevant answers — not just keyword matches.

  • Dedicated analytics dashboard with query management and helpfulness voting
  • Customizable block text, greeting title, popular keywords, and predefined questions
  • Expanded styling controls for full visual customization
  • Up to 100 lifetime search queries on the free plan

Smart Knowledge Base — The AI Brain of Your Site

The knowledge base is the engine that powers every AI feature in Antimanual. It stores vector embeddings of your content so the chatbot, search, generators, and translators can deliver accurate, context-aware results.

  • Add any WordPress post or page with one click
  • Automatic content chunking and embedding for optimal AI retrieval
  • Knowledge Base auto-sync: automatically update embeddings when posts change (Pro)
  • Advanced table view with bulk actions, filters, and pagination

Modern Admin Dashboard — Fast and Intuitive

Manage everything from a fast, React-based single-page application inside WordPress admin. Pages load instantly with no full-page reloads.

  • AES-256-CBC encryption for all API keys — keys are never exposed to the frontend
  • Validated model selection — only shows models available for your API key
  • Advanced tables with search, sort, and pagination across all features
  • Lazy-loaded admin pages for faster initial load

Pro Features — Unlock Unlimited Power

Upgrade to Antimanual Pro to remove all usage limits and unlock premium features unavailable in the free version.

Unlimited Usage Across All Features

All monthly and lifetime caps are lifted. Nothing is held back on conversations, auto-posting schedules, bulk rewrites, forum automation answers, topic conversions, or AI search queries.

Google Gemini AI Support

Use Google Gemini models (Gemini 2.5 Pro, Gemini 2.5 Flash, Gemini 2.0 Flash, and more) alongside or instead of OpenAI. Gemini support includes chat, embeddings, and multi-modal file processing for images, PDFs, audio, and video content.

Expanded Knowledge Base: PDFs, URLs, Text & GitHub

Go beyond WordPress posts. Add PDFs, external website URLs, custom text blocks, and GitHub repositories to your knowledge base — giving your chatbot and search far richer, more accurate context to draw from.

GitHub Repository Integration

Connect your GitHub account and index documentation directly from your repositories. Antimanual automatically extracts README files, markdown docs, and repository content — purpose-built for developer products and open-source projects.

Knowledge Base Auto-Sync

Enable per-post-type auto-sync so your knowledge base stays up to date automatically whenever posts are edited or updated. No manual re-indexing required.

AI Translation — 34 Languages with Smart Controls

Translate your entire site into 34 languages using AI. Includes bulk translation, auto-translate on publish, a custom glossary for brand terms, tone and formality controls, translation history with filtering and deletion, and a frontend language switcher that swaps content via AJAX — no page reload needed. Full RTL language support included.

Cross-Domain Chatbot Embed

Embed your Antimanual chatbot on any external website using a simple iframe embed code. One AI assistant, deployed across all your properties — perfectly suited for SaaS products, documentation sites, and agency client projects.

Chatbot Leads & Analytics

Capture visitor leads through the chatbot and view detailed analytics. Manage leads from a dedicated dashboard — search, export to CSV, paginate, and delete records with ease.

Generate Post Batch Mode

Generate multiple posts at once from a list of topics. Shared tone, SEO, and scheduling settings apply across all posts in the batch — saving hours of individual content creation.

SEO Plus Plan — Built-In AI SEO Tools

Upgrade to SEO Plus to unlock the most complete AI-powered SEO toolkit available in a WordPress plugin, alongside all Free and Pro features.

SEO Agent — AI-Powered SEO Audits & Auto-Fix

Analyze any page — internal or external — for SEO issues, performance problems, and accessibility gaps. The SEO Agent scores pages across six categories: On-Page SEO, Technical SEO, Performance, Accessibility, Security, and Mobile Friendliness, then tells you exactly what to fix and — for many issues — fixes it automatically.

  • Quick Audit — Instant HTML analysis at no AI cost. Checks title tags, meta descriptions, heading hierarchy, image alt text, canonical URLs, robots directives, lazy loading, Open Graph tags, Schema markup, internal/external link ratios, SSL, viewport configuration, and more.
  • Full AI Audit — Deep AI analysis powered by GPT-5 or Gemini with keyword density evaluation, content quality insights, and prioritized fix recommendations.
  • One-Click Auto Fix — Automatically optimize title tags, generate AI meta descriptions, add missing image alt text, enforce lazy loading, and add rel=”noopener” to external links — all at once.
  • Bulk Site Audit — Audit up to 50 pages simultaneously. View a sortable results table with per-page SEO, performance, and accessibility scores. Export as CSV.
  • Bulk Auto Fix — Apply auto-fixes across multiple posts in one operation.
  • Score Change Tracking — Track score deltas between scans to measure concrete improvements over time.
  • Competitor Page Comparison — Save any scan as a benchmark and compare your page scores side-by-side with a competitor or target page.
  • SEO Checklist — 14-item on-page SEO checklist for tracking manual optimizations.
  • Keyword Focus Analyzer — Add up to 10 focus keywords and verify their presence in the title, meta description, and URL.
  • Report Export — Share audit results as Markdown, styled HTML download, or printable PDF.
  • SEO Monitoring Preferences — Configure automated monitoring with daily, weekly, or monthly frequency. Set score thresholds, notification channels (email, browser notifications, Slack), competitor …
sections.installation:
1. Upload the antimanual folder to /wp-content/plugins/, or install directly from the WordPress plugin repository.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to Antimanual > Settings in your dashboard.
  4. Enter your OpenAI API key to power the AI features.
  5. Add content to your Knowledge Base and enable the Chatbot — you are ready to go.
sections.faq:
What is Antimanual?

Antimanual is an all-in-one AI WordPress plugin that automates the most time-consuming parts of running a website. It includes a trainable AI chatbot, automated content publishing, bulk content rewriting, FAQ generator, documentation builder, repurpose studio, forum automation, AI-powered search, AI translation (Pro), SEO auditing tools (SEO Plus), and an internal linking suite (SEO Plus) — all managed from a single, fast admin dashboard.

Do I need an API key to use Antimanual?

Yes, you need to provide your own API key from OpenAI or Google Gemini — we don’t charge for API keys. Both OpenAI and Google Gemini are supported in the free version. Because you use your own key, you have full control over AI usage and costs — nothing is hidden or marked up.

Which AI models does Antimanual support?

The free version supports all current OpenAI models: GPT-5, GPT-4.1, GPT-4.1 Mini, GPT-4 Turbo, GPT-3.5 Turbo, and variants. Antimanual Pro adds Google Gemini models including Gemini 2.5 Pro, Gemini 2.5 Flash, Gemini 2.0 Flash, and more. The plugin validates your API key and shows only the models available to you.

Can I train the chatbot on my own website content?

Yes. The free version lets you add any WordPress post or page to the knowledge base with one click. The chatbot then uses AI vector embeddings of that content to give accurate, context-specific answers — not generic AI responses. Antimanual Pro extends the knowledge base to support PDFs, external website URLs, custom text, and GitHub repositories.

Is auto-posting fully automated?

Yes. Once you set up a schedule — choosing topics, tone, language, article length, and publishing time — Antimanual generates complete Gutenberg posts and publishes them automatically, including titles, content, slugs, and excerpt. The free plan supports up to 2 active schedules; Pro removes the cap entirely.

What are the usage limits on the free version?

The free plan includes: 60 AI chatbot conversations per month, 2 auto-posting schedules, 100 bulk rewrites per month, 100 forum AI answers per month, 100 forum topic conversions per month, and 100 lifetime AI search queries. Features with no usage limits on the free plan include: Generate Post with AI, Repurpose Studio, FAQ Generator, Docs Generator, and Auto Update. Upgrading to Pro removes all usage caps across every feature.

What exactly is in the SEO Plus plan?

SEO Plus includes everything in the free and Pro plans, plus two dedicated SEO modules. The SEO Agent runs AI-powered audits on any internal or external page, covers On-Page SEO, Technical SEO, Performance, Accessibility, Security, and Mobile Friendliness, and can auto-fix many common issues with a single click. The Internal Linking module provides a full link audit (orphan pages, link health score), AI link suggestions, bulk auto-linking, a visual site map, topic cluster builder, and anchor manager.

How does Internal Linking work?

The Internal Linking module (SEO Plus) analyses all posts and pages on your site to build a complete link report — showing total posts, orphan pages, inbound/outbound link counts, average links per post, and a Link Health Score. You can then generate AI-powered internal link suggestions for any post, apply links in bulk, visualise your entire site’s link structure, organise content into topic clusters, and manage all anchor texts from one place.

What languages does AI Translation support?

Antimanual Pro includes AI translation for 34 languages. You can run bulk translations across all your posts, enable auto-translate on publish so new content is always translated, add a custom glossary to protect brand terms, control tone and formality, and display a frontend language switcher that swaps content via AJAX — no page reload required. RTL languages are fully supported.

Can I embed the chatbot on another website or domain?

Yes. Cross-domain chatbot embedding via a simple iframe embed code is included with Antimanual Pro. This lets you deploy the same trained chatbot on multiple domains, documentation sites, or client properties — without any additional configuration.

Does Antimanual integrate with community forum plugins?

Yes. Antimanual integrates with Forumax for AI-powered automatic responses to forum topics and replies. It also lets you convert closed forum threads into permanent WordPress posts or knowledge base articles with a single click.

Is my API key stored securely?

Yes. All API keys are encrypted at rest using AES-256-CBC encryption tied to your WordPress secret keys. Keys are never sent to the browser unmasked — the admin UI shows only a masked preview with a connection status indicator.

Can I use Antimanual with Google Gemini instead of OpenAI?

Yes. Antimanual Pro includes full Google Gemini support for chat, knowledge base embeddings, image generation, and all content generation features. You can switch between OpenAI and Gemini providers at any time from the API Configuration page.

Does Antimanual add any SEO markup automatically?

The FAQ Generator adds structured FAQ Schema markup (JSON-LD) to FAQ blocks for Google rich results. The SEO Agent (SEO Plus) can auto-add missing meta descriptions, fix image alt text, add Open Graph tags, and enforce proper canonical URLs — all editable before saving.

Schedule AI-generated blog posts to publish automatically. Pick your topics, tone, language, and posting schedule — Antimanual generates full Gutenberg posts and publishes them on time. Ideal for boosting SEO with consistent, fresh content.

  • AI-powered topic suggestion tool to fill your content calendar
  • Configurable tone, language, article length, and SEO settings
  • Weekday/time scheduling with optional expiration dates
  • Reliable queue system with automatic retry on failure
  • Real-time status bar with manual trigger and pause options
  • Generated posts history with search, filter, and pagination
  • Up to 2 active schedules on the free plan

Generate Post with AI — One Prompt, One Publish-Ready Post

Create complete WordPress posts from a single prompt. Antimanual generates the title, full Gutenberg block content, URL slug, excerpt, categories, and tags — ready to publish or review.

  • Smart prompt suggestions powered by your site context
  • SEO options: focus keyword, meta description, table of contents, and internal link suggestions
  • AI-generated featured image option
  • Batch mode to generate multiple posts from a list of topics at once (Pro)
  • Configurable author, status, categories, and tags
  • Full history with search, filter, sort, and pagination

FAQ Generator — AI FAQs with Google Rich Snippet Schema

Generate structured FAQ content from your knowledge base with one click. Review and edit the Q&A pairs, then insert them as Gutenberg accordion blocks — complete with FAQ Schema markup for Google rich results.

  • Generate from your entire knowledge base or specific sources
  • Customizable tone and topic focus
  • Interactive editable preview — add, edit, reorder, or delete any Q&A pair
  • Output as default Gutenberg accordion or Advanced Accordion Block format
  • FAQ Schema markup for SEO rich snippets in Google
  • Auto-saves progress to local storage to prevent data loss

Repurpose Studio — Turn One Post into Many Content Formats

Transform any existing WordPress post into social media content, email copy, video scripts, and more. Includes Quick Presets for Product Launch, Blog Summary, Event Promo, Tutorial Recap, Case Study, and Thought Leadership — making repurposing instant.

  • Generate X/Twitter, LinkedIn, and Facebook posts from any article
  • Create email newsletters and video scripts with hooks and CTAs
  • Six built-in quick presets for the most common repurposing tasks

AI Documentation Generator — Professional Docs in Minutes

Build structured product documentation with AI. Define the number of lessons, sub-lessons, tone, and target audience — then let AI write each section. Designed for SaaS platforms, software products, and any project that needs organized, professional docs.

  • 6-step guided wizard: Subject, Settings, Writing Style, Knowledge Sources, Generate, Review & Edit
  • Content depth, target audience, table of contents, FAQ, and internal link options
  • AI-generated featured image for the documentation
  • File upload support for custom source material

Bulk Rewrite — Refresh Dozens of Posts at Once

Select multiple posts and rewrite them with AI to improve readability, fix grammar, add structure, update outdated information, or optimize for new keywords. Antimanual preserves your existing Gutenberg block structure.

  • 8 built-in Quick Presets: SEO Optimization, Content Refresh, Fix Grammar, Make Concise, Add Structure, Conversational Tone, Simplify & Improve, Complete Enhancement
  • Custom rewrite prompts with saved templates and prompt variables
  • Automatically regenerate SEO-friendly excerpts, tags, and taxonomy terms
  • 100 rewrites per month on the free plan

Auto Update — Automatically Keep Old Content Relevant

Set up a schedule and let Antimanual automatically find and rewrite aging posts. Configure which post types to update, set a minimum age threshold, and the plugin handles everything else — without any manual intervention.

  • Filter by post type, post status, and content age
  • Update title, content, and excerpt independently
  • Configurable tone, language, and advanced prompt settings
  • Weekday/time scheduling with a stats dashboard
  • Exclude specific posts by ID

Forum Automation — AI-Powered Community Management

Integrate with Forumax and bbPress to automate your WordPress community forums. AI generates answers to new topics and replies, and converts solved forum threads into permanent blog posts or knowledge base articles.

  • AI auto-response for new forum topics and replies
  • Configurable minimum word count and role exclusions
  • Convert closed topics into WordPress posts with one click
  • Writing tone controls for AI responses
  • Customizable AI disclaimer text
  • Up to 100 AI answers and 100 topic conversions per month on the free plan

AI Search Block — Intelligent Gutenberg Search Widget

Add a smart, intent-aware search experience to any page using the Antimanual AI Search Gutenberg block. It queries your knowledge base to understand what visitors are looking for and returns relevant answers — not just keyword matches.

  • Dedicated analytics dashboard with query management and helpfulness voting
  • Customizable block text, greeting title, popular keywords, and predefined questions
  • Expanded styling controls for full visual customization
  • Up to 100 lifetime search queries on the free plan

Smart Knowledge Base — The AI Brain of Your Site

The knowledge base is the engine that powers every AI feature in Antimanual. It stores vector embeddings of your content so the chatbot, search, generators, and translators can deliver accurate, context-aware results.

  • Add any WordPress post or page with one click
  • Automatic content chunking and embedding for optimal AI retrieval
  • Knowledge Base auto-sync: automatically update embeddings when posts change (Pro)
  • Advanced table view with bulk actions, filters, and pagination

Modern Admin Dashboard — Fast and Intuitive

Manage everything from a fast, React-based single-page application inside WordPress admin. Pages load instantly with no full-page reloads.

  • AES-256-CBC encryption for all API keys — keys are never exposed to the frontend
  • Validated model selection — only shows models available for your API key
  • Advanced tables with search, sort, and pagination across all features
  • Lazy-loaded admin pages for faster initial load

Pro Features — Unlock Unlimited Power

Upgrade to Antimanual Pro to remove all usage limits and unlock premium features unavailable in the free version.

Unlimited Usage Across All Features

All monthly and lifetime caps are lifted. Nothing is held back on conversations, auto-posting schedules, bulk rewrites, forum automation answers, topic conversions, or AI search queries.

Google Gemini AI Support

Use Google Gemini models (Gemini 2.5 Pro, Gemini 2.5 Flash, Gemini 2.0 Flash, and more) alongside or instead of OpenAI. Gemini support includes chat, embeddings, and multi-modal file processing for images, PDFs, audio, and video content.

Expanded Knowledge Base: PDFs, URLs, Text & GitHub

Go beyond WordPress posts. Add PDFs, external website URLs, custom text blocks, and GitHub repositories to your knowledge base — giving your chatbot and search far richer, more accurate context to draw from.

GitHub Repository Integration

Connect your GitHub account and index documentation directly from your repositories. Antimanual automatically extracts README files, markdown docs, and repository content — purpose-built for developer products and open-source projects.

Knowledge Base Auto-Sync

Enable per-post-type auto-sync so your knowledge base stays up to date automatically whenever posts are edited or updated. No manual re-indexing required.

AI Translation — 34 Languages with Smart Controls

Translate your entire site into 34 languages using AI. Includes bulk translation, auto-translate on publish, a custom glossary for brand terms, tone and formality controls, translation history with filtering and deletion, and a frontend language switcher that swaps content via AJAX — no page reload needed. Full RTL language support included.

Cross-Domain Chatbot Embed

Embed your Antimanual chatbot on any external website using a simple iframe embed code. One AI assistant, deployed across all your properties — perfectly suited for SaaS products, documentation sites, and agency client projects.

Chatbot Leads & Analytics

Capture visitor leads through the chatbot and view detailed analytics. Manage leads from a dedicated dashboard — search, export to CSV, paginate, and delete records with ease.

Generate Post Batch Mode

Generate multiple posts at once from a list of topics. Shared tone, SEO, and scheduling settings apply across all posts in the batch — saving hours of individual content creation.

SEO Plus Plan — Built-In AI SEO Tools

Upgrade to SEO Plus to unlock the most complete AI-powered SEO toolkit available in a WordPress plugin, alongside all Free and Pro features.

SEO Agent — AI-Powered SEO Audits & Auto-Fix

Analyze any page — internal or external — for SEO issues, performance problems, and accessibility gaps. The SEO Agent scores pages across six categories: On-Page SEO, Technical SEO, Performance, Accessibility, Security, and Mobile Friendliness, then tells you exactly what to fix and — for many issues — fixes it automatically.

  • Quick Audit — Instant HTML analysis at no AI cost. Checks title tags, meta descriptions, heading hierarchy, image alt text, canonical URLs, robots directives, lazy loading, Open Graph tags, Schema markup, internal/external link ratios, SSL, viewport configuration, and more.
  • Full AI Audit — Deep AI analysis powered by GPT-5 or Gemini with keyword density evaluation, content quality insights, and prioritized fix recommendations.
  • One-Click Auto Fix — Automatically optimize title tags, generate AI meta descriptions, add missing image alt text, enforce lazy loading, and add rel=”noopener” to external links — all at once.
  • Bulk Site Audit — Audit up to 50 pages simultaneously. View a sortable results table with per-page SEO, performance, and accessibility scores. Export as CSV.
  • Bulk Auto Fix — Apply auto-fixes across multiple posts in one operation.
  • Score Change Tracking — Track score deltas between scans to measure concrete improvements over time.
  • Competitor Page Comparison — Save any scan as a benchmark and compare your page scores side-by-side with a competitor or target page.
  • SEO Checklist — 14-item on-page SEO checklist for tracking manual optimizations.
  • Keyword Focus Analyzer — Add up to 10 focus keywords and verify their presence in the title, meta description, and URL.
  • Report Export — Share audit results as Markdown, styled HTML download, or printable PDF.
  • SEO Monitoring Preferences — Configure automated monitoring with daily, weekly, or monthly frequency. Set score thresholds, notification channels (email, browser notifications, Slack), competitor …
